name: iris_outliers
description: List the Iris rows whose z-score on one numeric column exceeds z in absolute value (z-score = (value - column mean) / sample std, computed with pandas over all 150 rows). Returns the column, the threshold, how many rows qualified (total) and at most IRIS_MAX_ROWS of them (default 50; truncated is true when some were cut), each row with its 0-based index, the four measurements, species and its z-score rounded to 3 decimals. z must be positive: z 2.5 on sepal_width yields 2 rows, z 0 would list every row and is cut at the limit. Pure and stateless. A post guardrail refuses any result above 50 rows or whose cells are not numbers.

z.description: absolute z-score threshold; 2.5 is the usual choice

total.description: rows over the threshold before the limit
